summary: Full agent fleet authored as Antigravity Skills. Each skill specifies activation triggers, inputs, procedure, scoring/decision logic with concrete coefficients, output envelope, rules, and failure modes. Recovery loop (Verification → Recall → Learning) is wired with explicit triggers.
lessons: Putting concrete coefficients in SKILL.md is what makes the Python sprint trivial — no further design decisions needed.
Recovery loop benefits from being a first-class concern (its own tier) rather than buried in Verification.
